# Zero Block CTA

A highly convertible Call to Action block designed to secure newsletters, sign-ups, or product redirects.

## Properties

- **Headline Title (`title`)**: Core banner headline.
- **Intro Description (`lead`)**: Sub-headline copy.
- **Primary Action Label (`ctaText`)**: Target action button label.
- **Primary Action URL (`ctaUrl`)**: Destination url path.
- **Input Placeholder (`placeholder`)**: Form field email placeholder copy.
- **Submit Button Text (`buttonText`)**: Subscription button text copy.
- **Layout Display (`layout`)**:
  - `layout-1`: Centered Copy & Newsletter form (Input field + Button)
  - `layout-2`: Horizontal Conversion Banner (Left copy, Right redirect button)
- **Theme Mode (`themeStyle`)**: `light` / `dark` / `gradient`
